body:
Parent: #5090. Required architectural prerequisite for the finite managed-publication acceptance in #5093/#5094 and #5108/#5095; final #5096/#5097 qualification consumes the result. Existing #5111 owns its DATA/PRIMARY/COW-budget/identity-registry changes and remains independently owned. This issue does not adopt an unfrozen external ABI or a second registry/budget.

The staged Apply and private allocator packet can prepare actual images and IDs before WAL, but the installed Pager still births metadata during growth and sync. A request-time capacity attachment cannot establish ownership of historical backing. That ordering gap existed in the frozen inquiry source; the local constructor foundation below now installs the scalar owner before Pager construction, but actual Pager backing is still unstamped and cannot yet be borrowed as a complete selected closure. Admission that locks only growMu also races allocMu's logical-frontier publication. Pager.Close does not join foreground growth, and retained stable-resource SyncThrough can use the Pager after Close. These are constructor and lifetime responsibilities, beyond a per-call allocation tweak.

Source inquiry: M worktree base `ae6b6a87090be5bf64554f68738a1fe103393aa9`, exact pager.go `d9dc2ee6e349b79b22a6bfe35067bf68fe4e58ed2bd8bf5f8685976c6df9cdab`, grow.go `2bd207c37d8bebe2f7a5bdea567dd6f5904ea3e6de794a13bafe088de69ba7c1`; proposal `1b0e5db0f01d288de34709bbb498f3098a25f816724fe97abacc9a90b284cf8c`. Independent read-only review confirms these gaps; no Pager implementation or performance qualification is claimed.

Deliverable: one coherent production PR and its constructor/admission/lifetime tests, allocation comparison and docs. Acceptance owner: #5090 ROOT. Sole implementation writer: the existing M worker, in its isolated lane. Reusable construction may proceed provisionally; dependent final merge/finite activation requires this accepted/merged contract.

Selected architecture and scope:

- Move the existing scalar resident master/scope implementation to one shared internal home and establish genuine installed creator ownership before Pager/Open/recovery births. Current requests only borrow its stamped closure. Preserve ordinary/default policies; an existing unowned or unsupported instance must refuse finite admission before WAL, never acquire retroactive first-request ownership. Resolve constructor errors and open/read-only/overlay/replacement-generation callers explicitly.
- Charge each real shared backing once to its intrinsic creator. Each request separately pays the complete actual loan and retains exact creator edges; wrapper/control births are separately charged. Four borrowers of one cache are four loans, not four resident copies. Original and replacement backing overlap remains charged until actual last use.
- Reuse the SAME Pager, growth, verification, prefetch, dirty tracking and Sync algorithms. Preborn bounded tables/controls/scratch must cover the actual installed logical/physical envelope and pending async successor. Admission follows actual allocMu/growMu/mu order. Atomic prefix descriptors may share fixed storage only when published headers never mutate, capacity is clamped and publication precedes logical highwater. Classify SetPageCount, configuration changes, foreign/async growth and every bypass. Beyond-envelope attempts refuse before file/mmap/bookkeeping effects while finite borrowers exist.
- Use one dirty representation and one serialized Sync scratch lifetime across all entrypoints and failure restoration. Cover range IDs/sort/ranges/chunk lengths, actual configured parallel worker controls, platform adapters, File/private-file/path/error controls and actual mapping attempts. The pinned Unix mmap helper retains a process-global map: eliminate that hidden ownership only through a reviewed same-Pager primitive with exact unmap and error proof, or classify it unsupported; do not estimate map capacity from length.
- Join actual foreground/grower/sync admissions before physical teardown without waiting under locks needed by the grower. Retain metadata/creator charges through the last index/Snapshot/stable-token edge, including retained-handle Sync after Pager.Close. Raw borrowed read lifetimes remain restricted. No new background worker, publication engine, WAL, scheduler or deletion authority.
- Integrate exact packet/highwater/ID/installed-writer preflight before WAL, then storage-only installation of the one prepared Apply and allocator futures. Mark the packet before any WAL attempt. After any WAL or physical-installer attempt, retain uncertainty and exact forward retry; no original-frontier rollback, shrink, guessed highwater or synthesized future.

Acceptance:

- [ ] Constructor, shared-loan and full old/new/control census exists at actual producers before birth; all relevant retained/request/creator edges are enumerated. Missing capacity/identity/provenance/configuration refuses before effects. No finite guard opens from formulas or component greens.
- [ ] Risk tests first, or documented existing-characterization exception: prebirth denial; allocation versus enrollment/pending async race; immutable reader publication; foreign/stale identities; split/internal+leaf staging; partial growth/mapping/Sync faults; exact dirty restore; four shared borrowers; retained token Sync after Close; last-edge retirement and ordinary unsupported fallback. Normal/race, reopen/recovery and affected modeled durability tests pass on the qualified platform.
- [ ] Performance-sensitive contract: trace public native admission through actual constructor/staging/install/ACK plus ordinary fallback; audit setup/page/request allocations, B/op and allocs/op, retained/peak memory, growth/sync/loan counters. Compare equivalent before/after ordinary and enabled public workloads with exact source/toolchain/fixture/durability/cache/boundary and the parent's frozen noise policy. Minimize avoidable tables/copies; unexplained material regression blocks. No current-only performance claim.
- [ ] Preserve P8192/Q237942/F32/V64, leaf8192, cache64MiB, whole metadata128MiB and physical reserve1,599,848,960 unchanged. Prove complete cumulative birth/retained/overlap fit before native admission; include histories/debt and every request loan. No larger cap, reduced default threshold or platform-guard waiver.
- [ ] Update architecture/contracts/write-path-and-durability/recovery/verification, native admission and typed-storage performance guidance in the same PR; storage-format docs/tests if a format changes. Review mature exact source, pass latest required TreeDB CI/final-base gates, then ROOT merge. This component does not close any parent performance or storage gate.

Decision boundary: freeze the concrete constructor/loan API, lock and lifetime map before Pager edits. If that cannot cover existing defaults and all actual retained users, revise the architecture here before further implementation. Preserve failed/source-only packets. The original R1 north-star, performance, correctness, storage and noise gates remain mandatory.


## Compatibility selection — 2026-10-08, 08:28 UTC

ROOT selects one existing Owner with actual ordinary constructor/birth census while no finite borrower is live. Ordinary/default growth keeps its present policy. Finite admission is strict: the complete actual live closure, all old/new overlap and reserved future capacity envelope must fit the unchanged128MiB before a loan is born or WAL is attempted. Once any finite borrower is live, the SAME owner's relevant foreign and async producers must enforce that prepaid envelope before effects. Missing producers, coverage or platform capabilities refuse finite admission. Ordinary tracking is not a finite budget waiver and may never turn a capped selected scope into an unlimited one. Shared intrinsic payload is charged once; each request pays its own complete cumulative reachable loan and loan-control births. No request callback/plan/DB is retained by scalar Owner/Scope.

Source-bound constructor/lifetime addendum: proposal `4c77fa5f74acc88bc34c114c9657bcb34ecf617217c3bab3f9ba91ffc5d8962d`, receipt `2d8db7081b2978daf107e6ecfa0f99f40c68ad01eb36388c57c0813b7a91afb8`. Shared resident-account migration is the first implementation slice. Pager edits still require the concrete constructor/loan/growth/sync/Close API and lifetime freeze; no runtime or fit acceptance follows from this decision.

## Current ownership and S correctness checkpoint — 2026-10-08, 09:20 UTC

The first constructor slice is implemented locally on the exact M source at base ae6b6a87090be5bf64554f68738a1fe103393aa9: the SAME scalar Owner/Scope now lives in internal/residentcredit, is installed before all three DB Pager constructors, and cannot be retrofitted by a request. Ordinary growth remains uncapped when no selected strict scope is alive; selected scopes enforce the unchanged128MiB total, retain actual owner/control debt through DB Close and refuse unsupported/closed creation. This is the scalar constructor foundation, not full Pager/Manager/cache/registry class coverage.

ROOT audited 118 intended top-level/140 named controls in each pinned Mac normal/race build, plus the same13 named platform skips; zero missing or failed controls. A Git formatting hook overlapped the final race run without changing tested source. The overlap is retained explicitly: scoped functional evidence only, no sole-host, quiet-baseline, Linux or performance claim. Constructor audit4bb6e49c3869afdcd9d3feff009b3ed72b6b0332cbc07297ea5db1ba7f74eaa9. Independent current-source review accepts the scalar foundation, receipt02d0470bdfe2212d756944c0f1e48ae209fc3009c4f9fbd2e3232ac1f4be06b3.

ROOT source-only grantc71dbb4d now selects the next coherent ownership slice, which addresses actual partial-constructor custody, joined/retryable Pager/index teardown outside DB gates, real Snapshot/stable-token creator edges, and tree/treePager scrubbing at actual last release. Raw exports must mark escape before exposure and refuse exposure during an actual selected loan. Requests enter C13 Capture/Prepare/ONE staged Apply only for that invocation; the original resident cell creator stays resident and old unowned cells cannot be retrocharged. Fixed SAME Pager capacity and complete platform/producer/registry fit follow that lifetime work. No new budget, registry, publication engine or first-request stamp is selected; #5111 remains independently owned and its actual existing COWBudget/arena/registry must be preserved in integration.

Allocator membership is composed and passes all184 top-level/330 named controls in each pinned Mac normal/race build, zero skips/fails/missing. ROOT audited actual whole10050-source/compiler/module/tool/input declarations and all phase/outer waits, audit2015b950cd7361e95e94620439c539b066e788c0a406aa5f4c42d73b2ff04ee3. Every staged image must belong to the exact current candidate in the actual owner ledger, including reused IDs; a highwater bound is insufficient. The first normal red is retained: the new fixture wrongly assumed hint2 must select2 while valid actual free-stack reuse selected5. The correction proves exact real reused/appended reservation kinds, original free membership and unchanged physical frontier without changing allocator policy. Full staged-output completeness and pre-WAL/forward-only uncertainty obligations remain open.

S draft PR #5112 is pushed at8844d70630b38266722264e0922a5c6e0ee67440. A real recursive cached writeMu deadlock discovered by both CI platforms and reproduced locally is corrected by ending observed value-source reclaim's fence before leaf GC takes its own checked handoff. Current-head15 checks are green. The exact corrected source passes15 top-level/36 named focused controls in pinned Mac normal/race, no skips/fails/missing; independent source review accepts it. ROOT audit8f824a4ef3de6f45775d4cfe20c902021b74ef75b4f22f37be9bdda5e0dcf34b. Common protocol v8 applies the same correctness correction to O/C/F and compiles normal/race; it executes no workload. N remains unset, natural rollover/held-current-reopen/physical plateau and matched public performance remain OPEN. Source staging on185 is being coordinated separately; no R1 runtime or111 activation is implied.

Full constructor/class closure, complete cumulative births and loans within128MiB, native finite admission, all original north-star performance gates and final merge gates remain CLOSED/OPEN as previously specified. Neither component controls nor compilation qualify the graph or authorize its closure.
title: [R1 architecture] Establish constructor-owned Pager residency and storage admission
